name: Ord Namurt
description: Ord Namurt was an Outer Rim planet in the Galactic Republic, and the site of an Ordnance/Regional Depot. An'ya Kuro, known as the Dark Woman, had a training ground for Jedi students on the planet. She was training Aurra Sing on this planet when the girl was kidnapped by star pirates.
lead_paragraphs: Ord Namurt was an Outer Rim planet in the Galactic Republic, and the site of an Ordnance/Regional Depot. An'ya Kuro, known as the Dark Woman, had a training ground for Jedi students on the planet. She was training Aurra Sing on this planet when the girl was kidnapped by star pirates.
